recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source edit is needed unless a future build artifact reintroduces the obsolete wording outside the authoritative source checked here.
issue_request: FHIR-8684 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core ValueSet clarification against DSTU1. It reported that the Data Absent Reason value set page said "This value set is not currently used" and asked for that sentence to be removed.
initial_application: The Jira comment records "svn revision 6973" as the application event. The imported git history does not expose an explicit FHIR-8684 or svn revision 6973 commit, but the current terminology source no longer contains the requested sentence.
additional_context: The current build still includes ValueSet as an active resource in source/fhir.ini, and DataAbsentReason is present in the terminology binding table and concrete resource bindings such as Observation.dataAbsentReason. The current source therefore contradicts the old "not currently used" statement and already reflects the requested clarification.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The obsolete usage note is absent from current source/terminologies/valueset-data-absent-reason.xml and source/terminologies/bindings.xml, and source grep found no remaining current-source occurrence of "This value set is not currently used".
